texts.title: A Debt In The Family
texts.body: {debtor.name} owes money. Not a ruinous sum yet, but the kind that grows, to the kind of people who are patient only while it does. {debtor.name} has not asked {self.name} for anything. The steward thought {self.name} ought to know all the same.

choices.say_the_house_stands_behind_its_own: Say the house stands behind its own.

texts.title: Out Of Their Own Pocket
texts.body: The treasury was short, and then it was a little less short, and nobody had been asked for anything. It turns out {giver.name} put in money of their own, quietly, through the steward, and asked that nothing be made of it.

choices.repay_it_when_you_can: Write it down as a debt of the house.
choices.accept_it_as_owed: Accept it as no more than was owed.

texts.title: A Mean House
texts.body: {kin.name} has come to ask, with visible effort, whether there is anything more to be had. The house gives its own almost nothing, and {kin.name} has reached the end of it. It is being said, {kin.name} adds, that the house of {self.name} keeps its people shorter than houses half as rich.

choices.they_may_earn_it: They may earn it, like anyone.

texts.title: The Will Is Read
texts.body: The house is {self.name}'s; nobody disputes that. But the dead head's own money, the will says, is to go in great part to {legatee.name}. It is read out in front of the family. Everyone looks at {self.name}.

choices.ask_them_to_give_it_up: Ask them to give it up.

texts.title: Sold Out Of The Family
texts.body: It had been in the family longer than anyone could say, and now it is in a dealer's window with a price on it. The sale was {self.name}'s to make. The family is taking it as though something had died.

choices.promise_to_buy_it_back: Promise to buy it back one day.
